description: A SEPS (Satellite Environmental Prediction System) desenvolve soluções de monitoramento ambiental utilizando dados de satélites da NASA, incluindo o NISAR. Integramos imagens SAR e análises geoespaciais para detectar mudanças na superfície terrestre, monitorar desmatamento, inundações e deformações do solo, além de identificar áreas vulneráveis e fornecer informações que auxiliem na prevenção de desastres naturais.
summary:
SEPS EARTH is an interactive web platform that transforms complex NASA satellite data into accessible, actionable information for everyone. Through an interactive 3D globe, users can explore natural disasters worldwide, filter events by location, date, and hazard type, and visualize satellite imagery from NASA Earthdata and ASF Data Search Vertex.

Beyond visualization, SEPS connects environmental monitoring with public safety. For each event, the platform provides clear, hazard-specific safety recommendations and local emergency contact numbers, including Fire Departments and Civil Defense services, covering 234 countries and territories.

Powered by a dedicated data-processing API, SEPS simplifies technical satellite information into understandable insights, making Earth observation useful beyond the scientific community.

By combining satellite technology, environmental awareness, and emergency preparedness in one intuitive platform, SEPS bridges the gap between scientific data and everyday decision-making, helping people understand the risks around them and respond more effectively when disasters strike.
details:
SEPS Earth is an interactive web platform designed to make complex Earth observation data accessible, understandable, and useful for everyone. By combining satellite information with an interactive 3D globe, SEPS helps users explore natural disasters, understand environmental changes, and access essential emergency information.

How It Works

Users navigate a 3D Earth interface, select geographic locations, and explore natural events such as floods, wildfires, earthquakes, volcanic activity, and severe storms. The platform integrates data from NASA's Earth Observing System Data and Information System (Earthdata), NASA EONET, and the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF), including data associated with the NISAR mission.

Our custom backend API collects, standardizes, filters, and processes geospatial information. For supported events, the system can search for satellite observations before and after an event, enabling comparisons of environmental conditions and changes in radar backscatter. The processed information is delivered to the interactive globe in a more accessible format.

SEPS also connects environmental awareness with public safety. Users can access hazard-specific safety recommendations and emergency contact information for Fire Departments and Civil Defense services across 234 countries and territories.

Technologies Used

The platform was developed using Python, FastAPI, JavaScript, TypeScript, and MapLibre GL JS for interactive globe visualization. Additional technologies include HTTPX, Pandas, Shapely, and the ASF Search library. The backend is hosted using Amazon Web Services (AWS), while the frontend is designed as a lightweight, static website.

Innovation and Impact

What makes SEPS distinctive is its combination of satellite-based environmental monitoring, interactive visualization, and practical disaster preparedness in a single platform.

Instead of presenting complex scientific datasets that require specialized knowledge, SEPS transforms them into a visual experience that everyday users can explore. Its modular architecture allows multiple official data sources to be integrated while keeping the interface simple and intuitive.

Our team prioritized accessibility, usability, reliable data sources, and global relevance. We also recognize that satellite observations have limitations and that environmental changes detected through radar imagery require careful interpretation.

Our goal is to bridge the gap between space technology and communities, helping people understand our changing planet, recognize environmental risks, and make more informed decisions during emergencies.
